intro.title: Welcome to Figuig — oasis and ksour of the east
intro.p1: Figuig is an oasis town in eastern Morocco, close to the Algerian border. It is known for its dense date-palm groves, traditional mud-brick ksour and a slower rhythm far from the main tourist circuits of the west and south.
intro.p2: Plan one or two nights to walk the palm gardens, explore the fortified quarters and sense a genuine border-oasis culture. Summer is very hot; autumn to spring is the comfortable window for walking the oasis.

oasis.title: Palm oasis & gardens
oasis.p1: Figuig's identity is the oasis: tight stands of date palms, irrigation channels and small plots that stay green against the surrounding dry land.
oasis.p2: Walk in the cooler hours. Paths can be narrow; respect private gardens and local farmers.
oasis.tip: Morning light through the palms is the classic Figuig image.

ksour.title: Ksour of Figuig
ksour.p1: Figuig is made of several traditional ksour — fortified mud-brick quarters with alleys, shared walls and a strong sense of community architecture.
ksour.p2: Explore slowly and ask before photographing people or private doorways. The fabric is lived-in, not a museum set.
ksour.tip: A local guide helps read the layout of the different ksour.

zenaga.title: Zenaga ksar
zenaga.p1: Zenaga is among the most visited ksour of Figuig: compact lanes, traditional houses and a clear example of oasis defensive architecture.
zenaga.p2: Go early or late in the day for softer light and fewer people on narrow paths.
zenaga.tip: Combine with a palm-garden walk the same morning.

dates.title: Date culture
dates.p1: Dates are the economic and cultural core of Figuig — local varieties, harvest seasons and a long tradition of oasis farming.
dates.p2: Seasonal markets and farm edges show the cycle; buy from producers when you can.
dates.tip: Harvest period (often autumn) is the most animated time in the oasis.

views.title: Desert-edge views
views.p1: Around Figuig the oasis ends and dry hills and steppe begin — open views that explain why the palms matter so much.
views.p2: Short roadside or ridge stops are enough; heat builds fast in summer.
views.tip: Sunset from the edge of the palms is memorable.

town.title: Town centre
town.p1: The modern centre holds cafés, shops and transport — the practical base between ksour walks and oasis paths.
town.p2: Use it for meals and restocking; the historic character sits mainly in the ksour and gardens.
town.tip: Good place for mint tea after a morning in Zenaga.

q1.question: How long should I stay in Figuig?
q1.answer: One night covers a ksour and oasis walk; two nights if you want a slower pace and more garden time.

q2.question: What are the ksour?
q2.answer: Traditional fortified mud-brick quarters that make up historic Figuig — lived-in architecture, not empty ruins.

q3.question: How do I get to Figuig?
q3.answer: By road from Oujda (about 4–5 hours) or Bouarfa (about 1.5–2 hours). Public transport is limited; plan connections carefully.

q4.question: Is Figuig very hot?
q4.answer: Yes in summer. Prefer October–April for comfortable oasis walking; always carry water.
